text:
tony_sourcing: FYI vendor just flagged a 20% allocation cut for our H100 Q2 order. they need PO confirm or they'll push to Q3.
maria_ops: ugh. which skus and which datacenters?
tony_sourcing: 8x H100-80GB, region: eu-west and ap-southeast. vendor says customs backlog in NL is part of it.
cheng_vendor: Confirmed. We had a container diverted. ETA for replacements 2-3 weeks delay unless we accept air split (extra cost).
ryan_infra: 2-3 weeks will blow our Dedicated onboarding. any interim loaners?
julie_logistics: We have 12 loaner cards available in NL depot. Shipping to APAC will be +48h air, cost estimate ~€9k.
ana_finance: tag:ana_finance — can we absorb €9k one-off? what's impact vs SLA credits?
maria_ops: tradeoff: time to market vs cost. suggest combine replacement RMA shipments with new allocation to avoid extra customs entry fees.
cheng_vendor: Good idea — we can consolidate AWBs. Need manifest + RMA numbers by EOD.
julie_logistics: Sending manifest template now:
```
AWB,SKU,Serial,RMA#,Origin,Dest,Incoterms
```
tony_sourcing: I'll push serial list and RMA IDs after 11:30am call.
logistics_bot: AWB 234-998 updated by @julie_logistics at 11:47 — status: consolidated
ryan_infra: also flagging routing through DE instead of NL may reduce hold time per forwarder's note.
cheng_vendor: DE route ok but adds 2x handling fees; still cheaper than air.
maria_ops: ok proceed DE consolidation. Tony, confirm PO addendum for custom handling and loaner schedule.
tony_sourcing: on it. will update thread with PO ref and earmarked budget.
julie_logistics: noted. will prepare carrier booking and provisional customs invoice.
ana_finance: approved provisional spend up to €15k for consolidation/loaners — tag:ana_finance
maria_ops: thanks. keeping infra + sla leads posted.
